decisions.target: customers who live paycheck to paycheck

actions.action: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. We have added 50 support staff for the coming weeks.
decisions.why:
Chosen by the optimizer for week 2 (customers who live paycheck to paycheck).
Actions: Savings boost on new money only, 4 weeks, Extra support staff for 4 weeks.
Cost $1,050,000 of the $4M budget.

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, Cobalt savings earn an extra 0.25 points on balances up to $50,000. Instant transfers to other banks are free for the next 2 weeks. You can order a free new card at any time, and we now send an alert for every card payment.
